about: Renders a trigger that shows and hides the content beneath it.
arrives: Arrives Thursday between nine and noon. Somebody has to be in to sign for it.

motion.about: Every motion: the content slides, fades, or appears at once. Press a trigger to see it.
motion.title: Motion

palette.about: Every palette, open in the subtle look, which fills the box with the palette's subtle fill. A warning or an error palette marks content a page wants read before it is opened.
palette.title: Palettes

preview.about: With `collapsedHeight="2lh"`, the closed content keeps its first two lines visible, and the trigger shows the rest.
preview.title: Preview

size.about: Every size, closed. The size sets the trigger, the indicator and the content's padding.
size.title: Sizes

terms: Deliveries run Monday to Friday and arrive between eight in the morning and six in the evening. A parcel nobody is in for goes to the depot named on the card, where it is held for ten days. A parcel a courier could not fit through the door is brought back the next working day at no charge. Where a delivery is late by more than a working day the postage is returned, and where it is late by three the order is.
title: Collapsible

variant.about: Every look, open. The surface look adds a shadow to the outline look's edge.
variant.title: Looks
